seo.title: Privacy policy (draft) | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: How RNC Landscaping handles quote requests sent from your email app, what stays in your browser, and our cookieless Plausible analytics. Draft for legal review.

lede: Draft for legal review. This page has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer and must not be relied on as final.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: [LEGAL NAME], operating as RNC Landscaping, [ADDRESS]. Privacy questions: [EMAIL].

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you request a quote, the form opens a new email in your own email app; nothing is sent until you press send there. The email contains what you choose to include: the services you need, your municipality, a description of the job, preferred timing, your name, how you would like us to reply, your phone number if you ask us to call or text, and any photos you attach. Your email address comes with the message from your email app.
This website does not collect or store what you type into the quote form, and we do not ask for payment information on this website.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
body: To respond to your request, prepare a quote, schedule a site visit and carry out work you agree to. We do not sell personal information or use it for unrelated marketing without your consent.

sections.heading: Consent
body: By sending us a request, you agree that we may use the details in it to respond. You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting [EMAIL], subject to legal or contractual limits.

sections.heading: Where it is stored
body: Quote requests and messages arrive in our business email account. Our email and website hosting providers may store data outside Canada, including in the United States, where it may be subject to local laws. A list of these providers is available on request.

sections.heading: What stays in your browser
body: While you fill in the quote form, a draft is kept in your browser's session storage so it survives going back after your email app opens. It is not a cookie, is never sent to us, and is cleared when you close the tab.
If you use the copy buttons, the text goes to your device's clipboard only. The Gmail and Outlook links open those services with your request filled in; their own privacy policies apply.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
body: We use Plausible Analytics, a cookieless analytics service, to count visits in aggregate. It does not set cookies, does not collect personal information that identifies you, and does not track you across other websites. It is loaded only on the live site.

We also count a few anonymous actions, such as opening the quote email or tapping the call button, together with the service and municipality chosen. These events never include your name, phone number, email address or message. This site does not set tracking cookies, so there is no cookie banner.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep quote requests only as long as needed for the purposes above and for our business records.

sections.heading: How we protect it
body: We limit access to people who need it and use reasonable security safeguards with our service providers.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may ask to see or correct the personal information we hold about you. Contact [EMAIL]. If you're not satisfied, you may contact the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia.
